text:
I’m the game director!\c
The Rotom Dex is pretty fun, isn’t it?
If you manage to fill in some of your Pokédexes,
come and show me, would you?

I’m the game director!\c
Oh! I know what that face means!
That’s a face that says you filled in a Pokédex!\c
Let’s see what you’ve done...\c
Whoa! You’ve registered all the Pokémon that
can be found on Melemele Island!
You did it! Congratulations!\nYou completed the Melemele Pokédex!

I’m the game director!\c
Oh! I know what that face means!
That’s a face that says you filled in a Pokédex!\c
Let’s see what you’ve done...\c
Yikes! You’ve gone and found all the Pokémon
for Akala Island!
Amazing! Congratulations!\nYou completed the Akala Pokédex!

I’m the game director!\c
Oh! I know what that face means!
That’s a face that says you filled in a Pokédex!\c
Let’s see what you’ve done...\c
Oho! You’ve got every Pokémon that can be
found on Ula’ula Island here!
That’s just like you! Congratulations!\nYou completed the Ula’ula Pokédex!

I’m the game director!\c
Oh! I know what that face means!
That’s a face that says you filled in a Pokédex!\c
Let’s see what you’ve done...\c
Oh, wow! You’ve registered all the Pokémon
for Poni Island!
That’s superb! Congratulations!\nYou completed the Poni Pokédex!

I’m the game director!\c
Oh! Now what is that invigorating expression
you’ve got on your face? Could it be?
Are you here to show me a Pokédex?\c
... ... ...
Oh! Whoooaaa! No way!\c
You’ve completed the entire Alola Pokédex!
It’s amazing! Amaza-laz-a-ling!
You’re too much! Cannot compute!
This is really truly an astounding feat!\nCongratulations on completing the Pokédex!

Phew! There!\c
I’m glad I didn’t mess up the stamp. And...it
looks like your Trainer Passport leveled up, too!\c
Come see me again anytime if you manage to
fill in another Pokédex!

Phew! There!\c
I may have stamped that one a bit harder than
necessary, but I couldn’t seem to help it!\c
I feel honored that I get to help a great Trainer
like you celebrate your achievement!

I’m the game director!\c
Hey, it’s you again!
The master of the Alola Pokédex!\c
Now that you’ve filled in your entire Pokédex,
have fun visiting lots of different facilities and
places with your Pokémon. Enjoy Alola!\c
And get along with your Rotom Dex, too!
Thanks again for playing!
I’ll go ahead and give you a new stamp to\ncommemorate completing a Pokédex!\r\nHere we go! Bam!

All right, then! I’m going to give your Trainer
Passport the super-special stamp I’ve been
holding back this whole time!
Here we go! Bam!

I really want to reward you somehow for your
mastery in Pokédexing!
Let’s see what I can dig out of my pocket...\c
Boy, I feel like a Picker-Upper!
My Secret Base was Gold Rank, by the way.\c
And...ta-da! It’s a Shiny Charm!
Just having one of these makes it more likely
that you’ll encounter Shiny Pokémon!

And that’s not all!\c
Here’s a little something special that would go
well on a tireless Trainer like you, who’s been
running all around Alola to fill your Pokédex!
You received a set of the Karate Gi Jacket and\nKarate Gi Pants!

And that’s not all!\c
Here’s a little something special that would go
well on a veteran Trainer like you, who learned
Alola inside and out to fill up your Pokédex!
You received a set of a Pokémon Center Nurse\nCap, a Pokémon Center Nurse Top, and\r\na Pokémon Center Nurse Skirt!
